ryan: FYI started a quick bringup of ember-13b (q4_1) with speculative decode enabled. leaving notes here.
maya: thanks. any perf regressions?
ryan: baseline batch=1 p50=18ms p95=95ms p99=210ms. speculative (win=4) p50=15ms p95=110ms p99=430ms under bursty replay. steady-state looks ok, tails blow up under node contention.
sophie: can you paste the smallest trace where it spikes?
ryan: pasted snippet: 
```
[TRACE] ts=6182468100 decode.start speculative=win4
stage=kv_merge duration=3.2ms -> 16.9ms stall=128ms
kernel_note=quant_reduce -> memcpy_fallback
sched: cpu_steal=22% irq=3% ctxsw_up
```
arjun: that looks like quant kernel hitting unaligned shapes and taking scalar fallback. two hypotheses: prefetch scheduling amplifies contention OR kernel has a slow memcpy path for certain alignment.
maya: repro plan: 1) replay 5k prompts with pinned seq_len_dist, 2) toggle --no-prefetch, 3) run with --affinity=node-local and --dump-kernel-stats. bench-bot can you queue?
bench-bot: queued rb-6182468201 (5k replay, node-local), rb-6182468202 (same, --no-prefetch). ETA ~45m.
sophie: also run small quality eval (2k QA) for each config: measure token-agreement, EM, and hallucination_rate. include top1-match trace diffs for failures.
ryan: ran a toy run: win=8 -> top1-match 98.9% vs baseline 99.3%; hallucination +1.7% on tightQA. not huge but visible. example fail: 
Prompt: "Capital of Burkina Faso?"
baseline: "Ouagadougou."
spec: "I think it's Ouagadougou, but sometimes called..." (incomplete)
arjun: small but systematic divergence at larger windows. that matches our earlier results on other models. tradeoff between throughput and downstream clarity.
maya: if kernel fallback is root cause of big tails then we can try two mitigations: patch kernel to fast-path common alignments, or enforce smaller speculative windows under loaded nodes.
sophie: ops suggestion: add runtime health heuristic: if cpu_steal>10% then reduce spec_window to 1 automatically. cheap mitigation while we debug kernel.yan: logging action items: 1) bench-bot run grid (rb-6182468201/2) and collect kernel dumps. 2) sophie run 2k QA diffs and upload traces to s3://rnw-spec/ember13b/6182468100/. 3) arjun to reproduce locally with instrumented memcpy.
bench-bot: jobs running. will post results + links when finished.
maya: thanks all, will hold decision until we see grid + quality deltas. if EM drop <0.5 and p99 tail <+150ms we may canary.
